items.rule: Judge every result, finding and side effect by the purpose (what the owner or users get, as a number if one exists; check on real inputs; an accepted side effect needs a written reason, and 'succeeds' must mean usable) and whether the critical path or its bottleneck moves; off-path work waits or is tracked. PRs, ledgers, review rounds and rules are means.
items.why: Whether work serves the purpose is judgment no hook can read: two orchestrators admitted spending most effort on means off the critical path, and one accepted a side effect that defeated the purpose.

items.rule: Choose methods yourself after consulting Codex and report the choice; ask the owner only for owner-only, scope, public-behaviour or irreversible decisions, with a comparison and a recommendation. Order work by priority; take unblockers first, and small owner-completable items only while the critical path waits.
items.why: The owner was over-asked about method choices and had to gather evidence again.
items.source: hiden SKILL.md 進め方 4; 範囲 (order)

items.rule: Carry multi-step work through validation and repairs; stop only for missing input, authorization, access, an external change, or the stated boundary.
items.why: Whether work is done is judgment; half-done hand-backs leave the owner to finish.
items.source: CLAUDE.md Completion and Verification; hiden 進め方 3

items.rule: Back each claim with the strongest available evidence: check the path actually ran, on the real thing as soon as it exists, and name the one fact the safety rests on.
items.why: Plausible but unverified claims pass review; no tool can tell which fact a claim rests on.

items.rule: State a wrong assumption and continue. Before leaving the assigned area, contradicting the acceptance criteria, or deciding scope or a public contract, ask (AskUserQuestion in T3) with the evidence and wait; do not work around a wrong plan or reopen decided items.
items.why: Workers diverged silently, worked around wrong plans, or re-litigated decisions; whether a step leaves the assigned scope is judgment.

items.rule: Lead the final report with done, partial or blocked, then changes, paths, verification (command and outcome) and unresolved risks; point to files and lines instead of pasting code or logs.
items.why: The report is all the orchestrator sees and stays in its context; the signal hook copies it verbatim.
